title: Nvidia GTC 2026: How To Watch Jensen Huang's Speech And Why Now Is 'Golden Opportunity For Patient Investors' - NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA)
summary: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang is set to reveal updates on AI chips, software, and infrastructure during the GTC 2026 keynote, potentially unveiling new products and partnerships. This event is seen as a key opportunity for investors to buy shares, amidst the company's strong quarterly earnings and fundamentals but minimal stock gains.
sentiment_reason: Investors are cautiously optimistic, awaiting new product updates and AI spending indicators from Big Tech, but are tempered by the stock's recent flat performance despite solid fundamentals.
